parsed.reason: This message fails on multiple critical fronts. It uses incident language ("technical error") instead of owning the fault in first person; it implies the request is still waiting and will be retried (when it should say nothing changed); it names a technical cause it cannot know; it includes a link to the app, a retry instruction with a time ("try again in 5 minutes"), and a question mark. It also has a greeting emoji and sounds like support-desk language, not a competent friend. It violates nearly every requirement.
